name: GCB
recent: Guan Chong Berhad 公布截至2026年9月30日季度业绩，净利按年大增573.2%至2.7765亿令吉，但营收按年下滑38.1%。公司宣布第四次中期单层股息每股2.0仙，除息日为2026年12月1日。此外，大股东 Guan Chong Resources 多次申报股权变动，董事亦有例行交易申报。
notable: 宣布第四次中期单层股息每股2.0仙，除息日2026年12月1日，派发日2026年12月18日。
截至2026年9月30日季度净利按年增长573.2%至2.7765亿令吉。
大股东 Guan Chong Resources Sdn. Bhd. 在2026年9月至11月期间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 董事 Tay How Yeh 于2026年11月25日间接减持40,000股普通股。
营收按年下降38.1%，尽管净利大幅增长。
earnings: 截至2026年9月30日季度，营收为23.09亿令吉，按年下降38.1%，按季增长28.0%；净利为2.7765亿令吉，按年增长573.2%，按季增长9.7%；净利率为12.0%，上一季度为14.0%。

recent_en: Guan Chong Berhad reported net profit of RM277.65 million for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, up 573.2% year-on-year, despite a 38.1% decline in revenue. The company declared a fourth interim single-tier dividend of 2.0 sen per share, with ex-date on 1 December 2026. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Guan Chong Resources made several changes in shareholding, and directors filed routine dealing disclosures.
notable_en: Declared a fourth interim single-tier dividend of 2.0 sen per share, ex-date 1 December 2026, payment date 18 December 2026.
Net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 rose 573.2% year-on-year to RM277.65 million.
Substantial shareholder Guan Chong Resources Sdn. Bhd. reported multiple changes in shareholding between September and November 2026.
risks_en: Director Tay How Yeh indirectly disposed of 40,000 ordinary shares on 25 November 2026.
Revenue declined 38.1% year-on-year despite the sharp rise in net profit.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM2.309 billion, down 38.1% year-on-year but up 28.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM277.65 million, up 573.2% year-on-year and 9.7% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 12.0% versus 14.0% in the previous quarter.
